There's been a lot of changes to this place since its orginal and only review.
Aug 2016 • Couples
1st I don't understand why someone would review the place if they don't like the type of food they serve before even setting foot. With that said, Vit Gay has significantly changed since it opened. 1st, they expanded so the place is much larger. They also significantly enlarged the menu. While duck is the star, they also offer an array of shellfish, chicken, fish and some beef and pork dishes. Duck is prepared in every imaginable way. We only had a few duck dishes and all were excellent. Service is great and our waiter spoke perfect English. I highly recommend this place. Prices are very cheap as well.

Duck Restaurant serves duck in more ways than i can imagine
Feb 2016 • Family
To be straight up I do not have an acquired taste for duck however this was not my choice of restaurant so I went with an open mind. Be prepared that this is purely a "duck" restaurant. This is a new establishment which is quite narrow & cosy. The owner was particularly eager to serve us and welcome us to try his restaurant. I chose the crispy fried duck & I was pleasantly surprised. The duck was served crispy though tender & flavour-some on the inside. I intended to try other dishes however we were put off by the constant hovering & staring of the 3 wait staff. The owner continuously questioned us about the meal as were eating & stood in my personal space for nearly the entirety of the meal. I stated several times that we were fine & did not require any help but he did not leave. We chose to leave as soon as we finished the first dish.
